source: sqlite-utils 3.38 (https://github.com/simonw/sqlite-utils, commit 9d7da06), sqlite-fts4 1.0.3 (https://github.com/simonw/sqlite-fts4, commit f86b449), and the subset of sqlite-utils' declared runtime dependency closure needed by its library import path (click 8.5.0, pluggy, python-dateutil 2.9.0.post0, six), all vendored unmodified
